coverage_decisions.single_gpu: Matched Vulkan0 and Vulkan1 full baselines are included; prior Issue #43 results are diagnostic and do not authorize reuse.
coverage_decisions.dual_gpu: Dual Vulkan layer 1,1 is included; tensor/row split is excluded by target Vulkan policy.
coverage_decisions.context: Use 1024 for single-GPU baselines and bounded 1024->2048->4096 progression for dual layer, stopping at the first unexpected result.
coverage_decisions.kv: Default f16 K/V baseline only; no blind KV sweep.

objective: Produce terminal evidence classifications for matched single-GPU baselines and the applicable dual-GPU layer configuration without promoting historical diagnostics.
stop_rule: Stop at the first unexpected result; preserve the terminal classification and do not continue later jobs blindly.

publication.requirement: Only successfully parsed, context-consistent evidence may be considered for later publication review.
